prime_directive.strategy: Assimilate HTMX to transfer UI state logic completely to the sovereign backend, reducing client footprint to a pure rendering glass.

architectural_pillars.mechanics: Replace client-side React state reconciliation with atomic HTML fragment swaps (hx-swap), reducing client memory by ~85%.
Stream telemetry through htmx-ext='sse' over open HTTP connection directly binding incoming fragments via hx-swap='beforeend' with <12ms latency.
Locality of Behavior (LoB) enables agents to graft verified HTML directly into active viewport via hx-post/hx-trigger without JSON parsing overhead.
Z3 invariant proofs audit outbound HTML fragments at WASM32-WASI boundary, aborting microVMs if unverified script tags or XSS vectors appear.
